## Objective
- Remove gold, achievements/trophies, and upgrades from the existing game while preserving brawlers and unrelated gameplay.
- Keep the joystick recentering fix in `game-play.js`.

## Requirements
- Apply changes to the existing game without asking clarifying questions.
- Preserve brawlers and unrelated features; make every brawler accessible without coins.
- Remove upgrades and their gameplay effects; restore baseline HP, speed, jump, and damage.
- Preserve the joystick recentering fix.

## Decisions
- Keep the INDEX focused on brawlers and retain the selection structure without coin dependence.

## Work State

### Completed
- Fixed joystick recentering in `game-play.js` to use the measured geometric center of the base; this change is uncommitted.

### Active
- Remove upgrade, gold, achievement, profile-stat, match-reward, and end-screen earnings flows.
- Simplify INDEX to a brawler-only screen and make all brawlers accessible without purchasing.
- Remove obsolete arcade/end-screen markup and upgrade instructions, then remove related styles.
- Run syntax checks and verify the game boots.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Remove upgrade and achievement definitions, profile fields, DOM bindings, and upgrade modifiers from `game.js`.
2. Remove match rewards, achievement tracking, earnings UI, and upgrade-modified gameplay from `game-play.js` and `game-fx.js`.
3. Simplify `game-ui.js` and `index.html` to a brawler-only INDEX, with all characters accessible and no coin purchasing.
4. Remove gold, trophy, upgrade, earnings, and toast styles from `style.css`.
5. Run syntax checks and verify the game boots.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Character costs, profile/save data, upgrade/achievement definitions, HP/speed/jump modifiers, DOM bindings.
- `game-play.js`: Joystick fix, brawler selection, match stats/rewards, achievements, earnings screen.
- `game-fx.js`: Upgrade damage bonus and catch/hit achievement, stat, and reward tracking.
- `game-ui.js`: Arcade tabs, coin display, unlock/upgrade costs, purchase toasts, achievement UI.
- `index.html`: INDEX/shop tabs, end-screen earnings, and upgrade instructions.
- `style.css`: Coin, trophy, earnings, upgrade, and toast styles.

## Important Context
- No gold/achievement-removal or upgrade-removal edits have been made yet.
- `randomDuo()` currently reads `profile.unlocked`; preserve selection behavior while ensuring all brawlers are available.
- Upgrade modifiers include `upgradeBonus('power')`, speed/jump bonuses, and `maxHpFor()`.
- `runSpeedFor()` is also used by `game-draw.js`; preserve baseline movement and any required rendering references when removing modifiers.
- `game-ui.js` opens INDEX on the `upgrades` tab initially and after a match; update those calls when removing tabs.
